key_finding: Missingness is limited to four sensor variables.
business_insight: Use sensor-specific missing-value handling and continuous data-quality monitoring.

key_finding: Energy demand changes strongly by hour of day.
business_insight: Retain time-of-day and calendar context in energy forecasting.

key_finding: SITE_02 has the highest average energy reading; SITE_03 the lowest.
business_insight: Compare sites together with building and operating conditions.

key_finding: Asset types operate in different physical regimes.
business_insight: Use asset-type-specific health baselines instead of one global threshold.

key_finding: Fault readings show higher temperature, vibration and power than normal readings.
business_insight: Use vibration and other changing sensor behavior as candidate maintenance signals.

key_finding: Vibration shows the largest mean change within 24 hours before recorded faults.
business_insight: Use recent sensor behavior to support early-warning maintenance models.

key_finding: Occupancy and temperature show the strongest positive numeric associations with energy.
business_insight: Use occupancy, temperature, operating mode, asset type, building and time in energy baselines.
